name: Ahu-Nixta Mechanon
languages: understands Deep Speech and Void Speech but has limited speech

entries.name: Construct Nature
entries: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

entries.name: Critical Malfunction
entries: Critical hit vs. mechanon: 20% chance of striking its soul chamber casing stunning it until end of its next turn.

entries.name: Soul Reactivation
entries: Reduced to 0 hp stops functioning becoming inert. For the next hr if a Small or larger creature that isn't a Construct or Undead dies within 30' of a deactivated mechanon a portion of creature's soul is absorbed by mechanon and construct reactivates regaining all its hp + additional hp equal to the dead creature's CR. If it remains inert for 1 hr it is destroyed and can't be reactivated.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries: Two Utility Arms or one Slam and one Utility Arm.

entries.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Utility Arm
entries: Uses one of the following attack options:Grabbing Claw Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 8 (2d4+3) piercing damage. If target is a creature is grappled by mechanon (escape DC 13). Until grapple ends creature restrained mechanon can't use Claw on another target. Sonic Disruptor Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, 60 ft., one target, 9 (2d6+2) thunder. If target is a creature: DC 12 Con save or incapacitated until end of its next turn.Telekinetic Projector Mechanon fires a ray at a target it can see within 60'. If target is a creature: DC 13 Str save or mechanon moves it up to 30' in any direction. If target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried it is moved up to 30' in any direction. Mechanon can use projector to manipulate simple tools or open doors and containers.

attack.targets: Until grapple ends creature restrained mechanon can't use Claw on another target

entries.name: Adapt Appendage
entries: Swaps its Utility Arm with Utility Arm of any other mechanon within 5 ft. of it.

entries.name: Repair
entries: Touches an ahu-nixta or a Construct. Target regains 11 (2d8+2) hp.
